text: Semiconductor equities declined across South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Europe, and U.S. premarket trading. SK Hynix fell 14.65%, Samsung Electronics over 13%, Tokyo Electron 10.96%, Advantest over 10%, Kioxia over 18%, TSMC nearly 3%, and ASML more than 2% in Europe after prior losses. The selling occurred across memory, equipment, foundry, and AI-related firms.

meta.note: Broad synchronized declines coexist with differing regional and company-level magnitudes.

text: Coca-Cola reported quarterly revenue of $13.38 billion, adjusted earnings per share of $0.97, organic revenue growth of 6%, and global unit case volume growth of 5%. All reporting segments recorded volume growth. The company raised its full-year earnings-per-share and organic revenue guidance.

meta.note: Marketing activity coincides with results but is excluded as causal attribution.

text: Boeing reported second-quarter revenue of $24.56 billion, commercial aircraft deliveries of 171 units, and free cash flow of $631 million. The company recorded a $280 million charge on the Air Force One program, contributing to an adjusted loss per share of $0.76. Commercial production and development activity remained concurrent.

meta.note: Commercial operations and a single development program produce differing financial states within one reporting period.

text: Ford raised its full-year adjusted EBIT and free cash flow guidance after reporting adjusted earnings above estimates. Automotive revenue totaled $44.89 billion, while net income reflected $4.2 billion in restructuring charges related to electric-vehicle operations. Commercial operations, restructuring activity, and production recovery remained concurrent.

meta.note: Adjusted operating results and reported net results reflect different accounting states within the same quarter.

text: West Texas Intermediate crude futures rose about 4.4% to $82.73 per barrel after U.S. Central Command reported intercepting multiple ballistic missiles launched from Iran. Earlier in the session, Brent and WTI had settled lower as discussions regarding the Strait of Hormuz continued. Price movement and military activity coexisted within the same trading day.

meta.note: Intraday price reversal limits the event to an observed market state without resolving direction.

text: The U.S. Senate confirmed Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence by a 51-47 vote. The confirmation concluded the acting tenure and transferred authority over the Office of the Director of National Intelligence to a Senate-confirmed officeholder.

meta.note: Confirmation and assumption of office are treated as a single governance transition event.
